title: BluePhishing Attack Abuses Microsoft Entra OAuth Consent to Create Hidden AI Agent Identities
content_md: “BluePhishing,” a technique that extends OAuth consent phishing to Microsoft Entra’s AI agent model. The attacker needs only one consent click to create persistent agent identities inside a victim tenant.
